notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

% gen_roulette.py hardware-bitwidth 10
% Roulette hardware.rkt, bit width 10, n = 2, fuel 3: t(J, K) and c(J, K),
% bit K of the total and the counter entering the loop with J iterations done, on(J) while
% it runs; z(J, R) resets a cell before the R-th read of iteration J: counter (test, d),
% total (u), counter (sum, g), counter (step, f); x(J) leaves the loop at iteration J.
% tx(J, K) and tc(J, K): the sum bit without the carry, and the carry into it, of the
% total; cc(J, K) the carry of the counter (+ 1); r(K) the total at exit.
width(10).
fuel(3).
step(0).
step(J1) :- step(J), fuel(F), J1 = J + 1, J1 < F.
0.0001::z(J,1) :- step(J).
0.0001::z(J,2) :- step(J).
0.0001::z(J,3) :- step(J).
0.0001::z(J,4) :- step(J).
c(0,1).
on(0).
d(J,K) :- step(J), c(J,K), \+z(J,1).
nz(J) :- d(J,_).
x(J) :- step(J), on(J), \+nz(J).
on(J1) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, on(J), nz(J).
u(J,K) :- step(J), t(J,K), \+z(J,2).
g(J,K) :- d(J,K), \+z(J,3).
f(J,K) :- g(J,K), \+z(J,4).
tx(J1,K) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, u(J,K), \+g(J,K).
tx(J1,K) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, g(J,K), \+u(J,K).
tc(J1,K1) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, u(J,K), g(J,K), K1 = K + 1, width(W), K1 < W.
tc(J,K1) :- tc(J,K), tx(J,K), K1 = K + 1, width(W), K1 < W.
t(J,K) :- tx(J,K), \+tc(J,K).
t(J,K) :- tc(J,K), \+tx(J,K).
c(J1,0) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, \+f(J,0).
cc(J1,1) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, f(J,0), width(W), 1 < W.
cc(J,K1) :- cc(J,K), P = J - 1, f(P,K), K1 = K + 1, width(W), K1 < W.
c(J1,K) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, f(J,K), K > 0, \+cc(J1,K).
c(J,K) :- cc(J,K), P = J - 1, \+f(P,K).
done :- x(_).
r(K) :- x(J), t(J,K).
hi :- r(K), K >= 3.
res(0) :- done, \+r(0), \+r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.
res(1) :- done, r(0), \+r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.
res(2) :- done, \+r(0), r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.

% Roulette hardware.rkt, bit width 5, n = 2, fuel 3: t(J, K) and c(J, K),
% bit K of the total and the counter entering the loop with J iterations done, on(J) while
% it runs; z(J, R) resets a cell before the R-th read of iteration J: counter (test, d),
% total (u), counter (sum, g), counter (step, f); x(J) leaves the loop at iteration J.
% tx(J, K) and tc(J, K): the sum bit without the carry, and the carry into it, of the
% total; cc(J, K) the carry of the counter (+ 1); r(K) the total at exit.
width(5).
fuel(3).
step(0).
step(J1) :- step(J), fuel(F), J1 = J + 1, J1 < F.
0.0001::z(J,1) :- step(J).
0.0001::z(J,2) :- step(J).
0.0001::z(J,3) :- step(J).
0.0001::z(J,4) :- step(J).
c(0,1).
on(0).
d(J,K) :- step(J), c(J,K), \+z(J,1).
nz(J) :- d(J,_).
x(J) :- step(J), on(J), \+nz(J).
on(J1) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, on(J), nz(J).
u(J,K) :- step(J), t(J,K), \+z(J,2).
g(J,K) :- d(J,K), \+z(J,3).
f(J,K) :- g(J,K), \+z(J,4).
tx(J1,K) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, u(J,K), \+g(J,K).
tx(J1,K) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, g(J,K), \+u(J,K).
tc(J1,K1) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, u(J,K), g(J,K), K1 = K + 1, width(W), K1 < W.
tc(J,K1) :- tc(J,K), tx(J,K), K1 = K + 1, width(W), K1 < W.
t(J,K) :- tx(J,K), \+tc(J,K).
t(J,K) :- tc(J,K), \+tx(J,K).
c(J1,0) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, \+f(J,0).
cc(J1,1) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, f(J,0), width(W), 1 < W.
cc(J,K1) :- cc(J,K), P = J - 1, f(P,K), K1 = K + 1, width(W), K1 < W.
c(J1,K) :- step(J), J1 = J + 1, f(J,K), K > 0, \+cc(J1,K).
c(J,K) :- cc(J,K), P = J - 1, \+f(P,K).
done :- x(_).
r(K) :- x(J), t(J,K).
hi :- r(K), K >= 3.
res(0) :- done, \+r(0), \+r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.
res(1) :- done, r(0), \+r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.
res(2) :- done, \+r(0), r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.
res(3) :- done, r(0), r(1), \+r(2), \+hi.
res(5) :- done, r(0), \+r(1), r(2), \+hi.
res(6) :- fuel(F), on(F).
query(res(0)).
query(res(1)).
query(res(2)).
query(res(3)).
query(res(5)).
query(res(6)).

Base.Experimental.@compiler_options compile=min optimize=0 infer=false

observe!(path, c) = (EV[] = EV[] & (!path | c); true)

function shr(x::DistUInt{W}, n::Integer) where W
    k = min(n, W)
    DistUInt{W}(vcat(fill(false, k), x.bits[1:W - k]))
end

components(x::Tuple) = reduce(vcat, map(components, x); init = Any[])
components(x) = Any[x]
width(::DistUInt{W}) where W = W

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))
    pr(flip(0.7))
    pr(a, z, y, t...; evidence = e)
    nothing
end

    x5_done1 = (false | x3_x1)
    x6_on1 = (true & !(x3_x1))

    x8_u1 = x7_z1b === true ? DistUInt{300}(0) : x7_z1b === false ? DistUInt{300}(0) : ifelse(x7_z1b, DistUInt{300}(0), DistUInt{300}(0))

    x14_c1 = (x13_f1 + DistUInt{300}(1))
    x15_z2a = flip(0.0001)
    x16_d2 = x15_z2a === true ? DistUInt{300}(0) : x15_z2a === false ? x14_c1 : ifelse(x15_z2a, DistUInt{300}(0), x14_c1)
    x17_x2 = (x6_on1 & prob_equals(x16_d2, DistUInt{300}(0)))
    x18_r2 = x17_x2 === true ? x11_t1 : x17_x2 === false ? x4_r1 : ifelse(x17_x2, x11_t1, x4_r1)
    x19_done2 = (x5_done1 | x17_x2)

    x22_u2 = x21_z2b === true ? DistUInt{300}(0) : x21_z2b === false ? x11_t1 : ifelse(x21_z2b, DistUInt{300}(0), x11_t1)
    x23_z2c = flip(0.0001)

    x25_t2 = (x22_u2 + x24_g2)

    x27_f2 = x26_z2d === true ? DistUInt{300}(0) : x26_z2d === false ? x24_g2 : ifelse(x26_z2d, DistUInt{300}(0), x24_g2)

    x30_d3 = x29_z3a === true ? DistUInt{300}(0) : x29_z3a === false ? x28_c2 : ifelse(x29_z3a, DistUInt{300}(0), x28_c2)
    x31_x3 = (x20_on2 & prob_equals(x30_d3, DistUInt{300}(0)))

    x39_t3 = (x36_u3 + x38_g3)

     x43_result = prob_equals(x32_r3, DistUInt{300}(0))
     if x43_result !== true

       x45_result = prob_equals(x32_r3, DistUInt{300}(2))
       if x45_result !== true
        x46_result = prob_equals(x32_r3, DistUInt{300}(3))

         x47_result = prob_equals(x32_r3, DistUInt{300}(5))

        end
        x49_result = x46_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(3) : x46_result === false ? x48_result : ifelse(x46_result, DistUInt{3}(3), x48_result)
       end
       x50_result = x45_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(2) : x45_result === false ? x49_result : ifelse(x45_result, DistUInt{3}(2), x49_result)
      end
      x51_result = x44_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(1) : x44_result === false ? x50_result : ifelse(x44_result, DistUInt{3}(1), x50_result)
     end
     x52_result = x43_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(0) : x43_result === false ? x51_result : ifelse(x43_result, DistUInt{3}(0), x51_result)
    end
    x53_result = x33_done3 === true ? x52_result : x33_done3 === false ? DistUInt{3}(5) : ifelse(x33_done3, x52_result, DistUInt{3}(5))
    return x53_result
end

function report(k, x, d)
    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

function run_program()
    EV[] = true
    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value
    for k in eachindex(comps)
        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))
end

warmup()
task = Task(run_program, 1 << 30)
schedule(task)
wait(task)
end

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))

        x49_result = x46_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(3) : x46_result === false ? x48_result : ifelse(x46_result, DistUInt{3}(3), x48_result)
       end
       x50_result = x45_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(2) : x45_result === false ? x49_result : ifelse(x45_result, DistUInt{3}(2), x49_result)
      end
      x51_result = x44_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(1) : x44_result === false ? x50_result : ifelse(x44_result, DistUInt{3}(1), x50_result)
     end
     x52_result = x43_result === true ? DistUInt{3}(0) : x43_result === false ? x51_result : ifelse(x43_result, DistUInt{3}(0), x51_result)
    end
    x53_result = x33_done3 === true ? x52_result : x33_done3 === false ? DistUInt{3}(5) : ifelse(x33_done3, x52_result, DistUInt{3}(5))

function report(k, x, d)
    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

function run_program()
    EV[] = true
    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value
    for k in eachindex(comps)
        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))
end

warmup()

schedule(task)
wait(task)
end

    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))

        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end

        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))

schedule(task)
wait(task)
end

    if x isa AnyBool

schedule(task)
wait(task)
